phase_A_basis: Phase A chunk A1 (96/96 COMP trials verified and valid, 32 per class, EXCLUSIVE quiet-timed + cargo lock, 1-minute loadavg mean 13.8) and floor replays of all 96 trials (F1 1248/1248 and F0 1248/1248 requests byte-matched). Per-mark cost c_m = 34.5 us (median of 1536 null-pair intervals). Numbers below are corrected per-task means in ms, excess over the F0 floor with its 95% CI; they are recomputed by analyze_b05.py from raw/ (the overhead control was still running when this file was written and does not enter the selection rule).

c_in.prep.menu_item: none: request-side session prep (ClientSession.send_request model build + memory-stream hop to the stdin writer) is not addressed by any pre-registered menu item

d_out.post.menu_item: none: Driver SDK post-dispatch work (runtime return, normalize, conform, handled) is not serialization or the stdout write; the menu's Driver items act on d_out.serialize / d_out.write / d_out.flush

c_out.route.menu_item: none fits: the memory-stream hops reader -> session receive loop -> request stream are not read buffering or chunk size (one response is one chunk: 0.2-1.8 KB frames, 64 KiB reads)

not_selected.d_out.write + d_out.flush: 0.176-0.207 ms excess, CI upper 0.21-0.26 < 0.5: the inherited single-write knob cannot meet the DELETED gate (and frames in T are 0.2-1.8 KB, below the 8 KiB BufWriter size where the knob changes the write count); not measured
not_selected.d_out.serialize: 0.024-0.028 ms: Driver compact serialization not measured (serde_json::to_string is already compact)
not_selected.duplicated text content: frames in T are 0.2-1.8 KB and payload-size costs (d_out.serialize, d_out.write, c_out.frame) are each < 0.25 ms per task; not measured (would be at most OWNER_DECISION)
not_selected.res.store_lookup: 0.025-0.036 ms per task: caching the snapshot-store lookup not measured
not_selected.others: every other lane sub-span is below 0.5 ms per task (see the summary)

candidates.menu_item: caller-side JSON parse replacement (caller only; outputs compared)
candidates.implementation: harness/b05_variants.py fast_parse: an exact JSON-RPC success envelope is decoded with json.loads and wrapped by JSONRPCResponse.model_construct; anything else goes through the library parser unchanged
candidates.equivalence: 100% of tools/call responses in both arms of B1: decoded message canonical JSON identical to the library parser's on the same bytes (harness/b05_equivalence.py); negative: the 10 malformed frames of harness/b05_floor.MALFORMED through the full client stack with the fast parser are all rejected

candidates.menu_item: caller-side validation replacement (caller only; outputs compared)
candidates.implementation: harness/b05_variants.py FastValidator: each output schema compiled at tools/list (outside T) into closures for the keywords the Driver's schemas use; accept -> no errors, reject -> the library validator's iter_errors (same best_match text)
candidates.equivalence: 100% of validated structured results in both arms of B2: accept/reject and error text identical to the library compiled validator; negative: every mutation of each captured result shape (missing/null/wrong-type/bad-enum field, extra property, non-object) gets the library's verdict and error text

design: per candidate: plan B (b05_browser.py --plan B --arms COMP_OFF,<arm>), 30 rounds, classes rotated per round, AB (COMP_OFF first) on even rounds and BA on odd rounds = 30 pairs per class, layer = chunk prefix; then N4a 5 per class in the candidate arm (same layer and routines); fresh Driver, Chrome, fixture and token per trial; EXCLUSIVE quiet-timed + cargo lock, each acquisition <= 25 min
gates: PREREG.gates unchanged; saving = paired mean (COMP_OFF - candidate) of caller_ms per class; DELETED iff >= 0.5 ms with 95% CI lower bound > 0, validity 100% in both arms, equivalence 100%, N4a 5/5 per class, negative control all rejected/matched; a T_runner CI entirely below 0 for the saving (candidate slower) is a regression
unchanged: binary B5 (sha256 f4149bdd...), configuration, oracle, analysis code paths for Phase A
